versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of adversarial-spec: structured, adversarial specification writer.
- Transforms a brief into a formal spec.md with YAML frontmatter, requirements, acceptance criteria, and target files.
- Git-aware pipeline with automatic branching, phase-driven challenge and revision loop, and squash-merge on approval.
- CLI supports selectable writer/reviewer commands, provider registries, and robust configuration.
- Emphasizes disk-based, English-only spec handling and clear prompt separation—no embedding of spec text in prompts.
- Includes comprehensive pre-flight checklist and persona-based workflow for clear, repeatable spec development.
